title: Voyager 1
description: Real mission: launched 5 Sept 1977; Jupiter and Saturn flybys; interstellar since 2012; farthest human-made object.

title: Voyager 2
description: Real mission: launched 20 Aug 1977; the only probe to visit all four outer planets; interstellar since 2018.

title: Pioneer 10
description: Real mission: launched 2 Mar 1972; first through the asteroid belt; first Jupiter flyby (1973).

title: New Horizons
description: Real mission: launched 19 Jan 2006; Pluto flyby 2015; Arrokoth flyby 2019 — the Kuiper Belt explorer.

title: Cassini
description: Real mission: launched 1997; Saturn orbiter 2004–2017; Huygens landed on Titan (2005); Grand Finale dive.

title: Juno
description: Real mission: launched 5 Aug 2011; Jupiter polar orbiter since 2016; mapping gravity, magnetism, and water.

title: Parker Solar Probe
description: Real mission: launched 12 Aug 2018; fastest human-made object — 430,000 mph; touching the Sun's corona.

title: Rosetta
description: Real mission: launched 2004; orbited comet 67P 2014–2016; Philae's historic landing.
